properties.source: NOAA PSL ICOADS 2-degree enhanced monthly long-term mean 1971-2000 (public domain, via NOAA ERD ERDDAP esrlIcoads2gec71): streamline of the annual-mean surface wind, traced by script for up to 1800 km from a seed at 17-23 N/S and stopped 6 deg from the equator. The north Indian Ocean is left out because its winds are monsoonal.
